environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running the Flask monolith in us-east-1a, deployed behind a public-facing ALB with target group on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on the ALB, and ALB forwards to instance on port 8080. RDS MySQL 5.7 instance in same VPC with security group allowing 3306 from app tier. No WAF attached to ALB. Instance has public DNS via ALB.

config.rds: MySQL 5.7, SG allows 3306 from EC2 SG
config.network: public subnet with IGW, NAT for egress
